traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Gymnosperms (DELTA, 2008 onwards, version of 5 August 2019), Ephedraceae, Gnetaceae and Welwitschiaceae: leaves opposite, in decussate pairs (in Ephedra sometimes in whorls of three, and Welwitschia bears a single pair); Ephedra nearly always dioecious, Gnetum mostly so, Welwitschia dioecious. Monoecious is the rare state.
